derivation: by simpa [discreteLinHom, discreteLinHomToLinearMap] using congrArg (fun L : X →ₗ[k] Y => L a) (Representation.linHom_apply (ρV := X.ρ.toRepresentation) (ρW := Y.ρ.toRepresentation) g (discreteLinHomToLinearMap X Y f))
explanation: Mathlib’s lemma gives the conjugation action on linear maps. Instantiating it with the representations underlying X and Y, then evaluating the resulting linear-map equality at a and unfolding the discrete-Hom wrappers, yields this theorem. The current proof is rfl rather than an application of the named lemma.
